description: Source code for the NXP i.MX CCM Rev2 clock control driver in Zephyr RTOS, managing clock enabling, disabling, and rate configuration for various peripherals.

methods.name: mcux_ccm_on
methods.description: Enables specific clocks based on subsystem, e.g., Ethernet clock if configured.

methods.name: mcux_ccm_off
methods.description: Stub function for turning off clocks, currently does nothing.

methods.name: mcux_ccm_get_subsys_rate
methods.description: Retrieves the clock rate for a given subsystem, handling multiple peripheral types.

methods.name: mcux_ccm_set_subsys_rate
methods.description: Sets the clock rate for specific subsystems, e.g., FlexSPI, with SOC-specific handling.
